summary: A district that shares a fair booth can owe volunteers even when another district is coordinating the event.
realLife: The 31st District chair said the neighboring 28th District was coordinating their shared Puyallup Fair booth and asked for volunteers in the room and online.
inGame: needs: lead district, shared event and open shifts.

turns.pulledBy: The local district fills its requested shifts.
turns.what: Its organizer sends the names to the coordinating district.
turns.writesBack: The shared roster can be completed.

turns.pulledBy: Volunteers are available but have not selected shifts.
turns.what: The organizer asks the lead district which times remain open.
turns.writesBack: Interest is not counted as full coverage.
